source: bench/recovery.py analyze() at arena 268fa3e (the first four logs) and at the arena branch of Oct 31 (the logs the site ships), on the log of each run (the same numbers GET /api/runs/{id}/metrics serves under `recovery`); times in seconds. `prefixes`: analyze() on the first `events` events of the log, as [events, ts_ms (the last event's virtual time), cdt_ms, blocked_ms, dup_calls]. `idle_prefixes`: the same, as [events, idle_ms], where idle_ms is round(1000 * idle_agent_s)
